summary: Frontend-only regression on /app/frontend/app/ledger/[id].tsx after user-requested follow-up fixes. Tested via Playwright at 390x844 (mobile) on EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All 4 requested items PASS. (1) SEARCH ALIGNMENT: Header ends at y=60; searchBarWrap starts at y=60 (height 56px) sitting cleanly below header with its own bottom border only — no double border. Search filter works: typing 'SI-30865' filtered voucher list to exactly ['SI-30865']. (2) SCROLL WITHIN DATE CARD: Screen-level document height equals window height (844=844, non-scrollable at page level); wheel over chart region did not move window (scrollY stayed 0). The inner ScrollView inside expanded 'Apr 25' card was detected at y=491-692 (clientHeight=201, scrollHeight=283). After wheel scrolling over the rows, its scrollTop advanced 0 → 82 while both month headers stayed pinned (Apr 25 at y=463.5, May 25 at y=703.5); rows visible shifted from {01,05,12,18} to {05,12,18,25}, confirming ONLY the inner card scrolled. Tapping opens Party Details modal (title 'Party Details' + GSTIN section visible). Not an 'i' character. (4) REGRESSION: Fixed bottom 'Share' button rendered at y=793 and is present when not in select mode; long-press on the SI-30865 row entered multi-select mode showing '1 selected' + 'Share PDF / XLS' bottom bar. No React Native deprecated packages introduced in this file.
